rendered.subject: Collaboration Opportunity for a Stumptown Coffee Roasters Instagram Post
rendered.body:
Hi Stumptown Coffee Roasters team,

We’re reaching out to propose a collaborative Instagram post that builds on your recent mission to honor your Direct Trade relationships, pay quality premiums for your coffees, and create multi-year commitments to your producers [P9]. We believe a visual post that showcases your dedication to these values would resonate with your audience and further deepen their engagement with your brand. This post would feature a curated selection of your favorite coffee blends, paired with a visually appealing quote or statement that reflects your commitment to quality and partnership. It would be a chance to further reinforce your mission and showcase your dedication to the Direct Trade model in a way that feels authentic and engaging for your followers.

Reply if you’re interested in exploring this further.

The BrandPilot team
